human_remainder.reason: Only the presence of the separate Concluídas and Não concluídas groups on Hoje (steps 3-4) is expressible. 'Lists only completed Tasks' is an absence check; 'collapsed by default' and 'shows its count' have no assertion in the vocabulary, and the header's accessible name embeds the count, which the seed changes between plan and run; the expanded rows (step 5) and the search results (step 6) appear only after an interaction, so they cannot be grounded; steps 7-8 are subjective (pt-BR reading, UI/UX checklist).
